scenes.text: A $25,000 dessert, and the spoon is yours to keep. Worth it?
Now the final course. The chef turns to the most famous luxury dessert in the world. It was served at Serendipity 3 in New York for twenty five thousand dollars, and it set a Guinness record.
The goblet is lined with edible gold, and it sits on an eighteen karat gold bracelet with diamonds.
You eat it with a gold spoon set with diamonds, and you get to keep it.
Team dessert or team rent money? Comment your pick below.
